input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III is a one-way ownership clause: Licensor owns the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein, and "INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS" (1.6) is defined solely as rights "of Licensor", while "DERIVATIVE WORK" (1.3) captures all additions, modifications and enhancements to the platform. Read with Article VII(b), the unique client front end and other enhancements we commission and pay for become Licensor-owned Platform Software, and we receive only a non-exclusive, Field-of-Use-limited licence that terminates with the Agreement (Article XXI) — no ownership and no perpetual, irrevocable licence back, so the clause fails both the preferred and the fallback position on deliverables. The Agreement is also entirely silent on our data: there is no reservation of rights in the trade, order and client data we transmit through the platform. Vendor keeping its platform is acceptable; the gap is deliverables we fund and our own data. Redline adds a carve-out for Licensee Data, assigns customization deliverables to us with a licence back to embedded Licensor IP, and bars joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee Data ownership and ownership/licence-back of customization deliverables to Article III
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III currently sweeps everything, including the custom front end and enhancements we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), into Licensor-owned Licensed Technology, and the Agreement is silent on our trade, order and client data. We have added a carve-out confirming we retain our data and intellectual property, that deliverables we fund are ours (with Licensor keeping its pre-existing platform IP and granting us a perpetual licence to any embedded IP), and that there is no joint ownership.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, information and content submitted, transmitted or generated by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology, including trade, order, market and client data and Licensee's configurations ("Licensee Data"), and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Licensor any Licensee Data or any other intellectual property of Licensee; (ii) all customization work, client front ends, deliverables and work product created by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including under Article VII(b)) shall be owned by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Licensee, provided that Licensor retains ownership of its pre-existing Intellectual Property Rights and the Platform Software and hereby grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any Licensor Intellectual Property Rights embedded in such deliverables for Licensee's business purposes; and (iii) no Licensee Data, deliverable or work product shall be jointly owned by the parties.
